relations.statement: The standard frame (e1,e2) and the rotated frame (p1,p2) are each orthogonal under dot
Vectors within each frame share the same normSq
Squared overlaps of a fixed ray with an orthogonal frame sum to the normalisation constant (Born/quadratic form is frame additive)
The quartic rival |<u,v>|^4 is not frame additive on the rotated frame
A two-label (Bool) host does not satisfy GleasonDimAtLeastThree
The enumeration of Bool has length 2, so the surrogate 3 <= |Q| fails

lemmas.statement: Born uniqueness of the quadratic form for d >= 3 is an imported Gleason assumption, not derived in the pack
On the rotated plane frame the quartic rival sums to 1/2 instead of 1, so it is eliminated by finite frame additivity
For the d=3 ray (1,1,1)/sqrt3 against the standard frame the quartic rival sums to 1/3, while the quadratic form sums to 1
The surrogate 3 <= |Q| is false when Q = Bool, since |Bool| = 2

near_misses.claim: Gleason uniqueness also holds in dimension 2, so frame additivity on the plane forces the Born form
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: In d=2 orthogonal frames are antipodal pairs on the circle; any f with f(theta)+f(theta+pi/2)=1 is a frame function, so the plane frames only eliminate specific rivals (quartic) and do not force uniqueness

near_misses.claim: The three-label cardinality surrogate 3 <= |Q| can be discharged on the Bool host
Finite rational frame obstructions (Cabello 18-9, d=2 plane, d=3 rotated frame) already mechanize Gleason frame additivity on S^{n-1}
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The mechanized theorems are closed computations on finitely many integer vectors; continuum frame additivity over all orthonormal frames remains an external import (gleason_pack_uniqueness_still_imported)

open_obligations: Continuum Gleason frame additivity on S^{n-1} for n >= 3 is not mechanized; cited only as an assumption via gleason_pack_uniqueness_still_imported
Exact coordinate values of p1, p2 and the statement forms of quartic_frame_values / quartic_frame_deficit were not visible in @SRC signatures, so no Lean skeleton references them directly
No @SRC declaration for the Cabello 18-9 configuration was listed; the 18*2/9 = 4 count is combinatorial only
Resolution of the two disagreeing unit-effect contract pairings is not addressed by any listed declaration
